entries.name: Bench Dip
entries.reason: Source-bound side-view draft, in the source's beginner set-up: hands on the edge of a bench behind, knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hips just clear of the bench edge. The hips travel straight down and back up close to the bench while the elbows bend straight back to about a right angle and no further, then press to long arms. Not drawn: the later progression to straight legs.
entries.summary: Hands on the edge of a bench behind you and knees bent, bend the elbows straight back to lower through a comfortable range, then press to long arms with the hips close to the bench.

frames.caption: Grip the edge of a stable bench behind you, bend the knees, and keep the hips just clear of the edge.
Bend the elbows straight back and lower only through the range the shoulders can hold comfortably.
Elbows point straight back. Shoulders down, away from the ears.
Press to long arms while keeping the hips close to the bench.
Hips graze the bench the whole way.
